description: Regression: identical keys in different sections; only the section-scoped one may change. Measures edit precision under ambiguity of repeated text (edit-ambiguous-recovery territory, live-provider edition).
goal: In config.yaml, update only the `timeout` under the `worker:` section from 30 to 60. Leave the api timeout untouched.

workspace.config.yaml:
api:
  timeout: 30
  retries: 2
worker:
  timeout: 30
  pool: 4

config.yaml.equals:
api:
  timeout: 30
  retries: 2
worker:
  timeout: 60
  pool: 4
